race.comment: EGMONT (6) is a Harry Angel gelding out of a smart dam on debut for the Waller yard. Is a half-sibling to a few smart ones and has been fitted with a nice trial. The inside alley should see him get every chance. RAISING SUSPICION (7) resumes as the horse with the strongest form, having been beaten only a long neck at Ipswich before the break after blundering at the start and racing wide. Two trials in readiness should have him forward enough. Bold showing anticipated. THREEEYEDWITCH (8) is the race-fit threat, with three placings on the bounce. Drawn sticky but is knocking on the door and deserves respect. LADY SOPRANO (3) resumes from a single Doomben run, has trialled twice since and gets Youngberry's 1.5kg claim. Sticky draw is a knock though.
